cd . && cp inbox/06-05/通讯签收.txt scratch/inbox/ && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
obj={r['案号']:r['对象'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('input/站务/章程.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
review={'HZ','NP','BA'}
rows=[]
for c in sorted(obj,key=lambda x:int(x[1:])):
    code=obj[c].split('-')[0]
    e=f"{code.lower()}.{'review' if code in review else 'service'}@office.test"
    m=f"{code.lower()}.service@office.test"
    rows.append([c,e,m])
with open('out/通讯.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n'); w.writerow(['案号','解释邮箱','维持邮箱']); w.writerows(rows)
print(open('out/通讯.csv',encoding='utf-8').read())
PY
